newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: FINANCE MINISTRY TO MEET DAIWA MONDAY.
newsitem.headline: FINANCE MINISTRY TO MEET DAIWA MONDAY.

text.p: Lithuania's finance ministry said on Friday that a meeting between Deputy Finance Minister Rimantas Survila is sheduled for June with representatives of Japan's Daiwa investment bank.
"Daiwa will introduce itself once again to the finance ministry," the deputy head of the internatonal department of the finance ministry, Ruta Skyriene, told Reuters.
"The chances for future co-operation will also be discussed at the meeting," Skyriene added.
